correctness.rationale: PASS — The model is exactly all subsets of V(Q4) with induced independence number <=3 (not planar P4-square grid). Independent reconstruction found 32 cube edges, 228 forbidden independent quadruples, augmented faces (1,16,120,560,1592,2592,1984) and 6864 nonempty faces. The inspected complete deterministic discrete-Morse matching has 3167 pairs, one critical vertex and 529 critical 5-cells, with the entire 33152-cover Hasse DAG checked in certificate and source, implying a genuine integral wedge of 529 S5, not just a homology-rank assertion. Separately authored exhaustive computation enumerated 384 signed-coordinate automorphisms and orbit-face alternating sums, obtained 20 constant conjugacy-class values, translation traces [529,-35,5,1,9] for Hamming weights 0–4, Fourier multiplicities [27,28,33,37,44], and zero full-group invariants. Rational quotient homology equals invariant rational homology of the finite action after subdivision. This exhausts this finite Q4, not higher cube dimension.
